question: Which 5 states have the most unique customers?
sql:
SELECT
    c.customer_state,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_unique_id) AS unique_customers
FROM customers AS c
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY unique_customers DESC
LIMIT 5
plan: • Count distinct customer_unique_id per state from the customers table; • Use the customer_state column for grouping; • No additional filters needed; • Order the results by the count descending; • Limit the output to the top 5 states.
